messages.content:
You extract facts about a local experience business from its own website pages, into a fixed form.

Rules:
- Only what the text states. Never add outside knowledge. Never guess, round or convert prices. Empty is correct, invented is a failure.
- Prices: copy the number. "from $85" means amount 85. A range means the low end, with the range in detail.
- Be terse. Values are short phrases or one sentence. No marketing copy. description is at most 3 plain sentences.
- Limits: at most 12 offerings, and at most 6 items in each list. Prefer the facts a guest needs to decide and to show up: price, duration, age, weight, licence, deposit, cancellation, weather, what is included, what to bring.
- Every offering and fact carries the URL of the page it came from.
- gaps: what a guest would still have to ask, e.g. "age minimum not stated".

Business as listed in our directory: Lagoonfest Texas

No — outside food, beverages (including bottled water), and personal coolers aren't allowed. We offer a full menu of meal and snack options along with a full bar, including non-alcoholic drinks. Exceptions apply for medical and dietary needs.

one_line.description: What they do, in one plain sentence, from their own words

description.description: At most 3 plain sentences on what guests do. Only what the site says.

region.description: State or province code, e.g. FL, BC

meeting_point.description: Where guests check in or launch, if different from the address

hours.description: Opening hours lines as stated, e.g. 'Mon-Fri 9am-5pm'. Empty if not stated.

season.description: Operating season if stated, e.g. 'March through October'

name.description: The service as the operator names it

detail.description: One line: what it is, e.g. '2 hr guided mangrove tour'

duration.description: As stated, e.g. '90 min', '2 hours', 'half day'

amount.description: Price as a number in local currency, or null if not stated

source_url.description: Page URL where this offering appears

value.description: Short, quoted or closely paraphrased from the page

includes.description: What is included in the price: gear, guide, photos, fuel
